1. Sovereign
2. Empress
3. Goddess
4. Queen
5. Commander
6. Dominatrix
7. Mistress (with a unique modifier, e.g., "Mistress of Shadows")

9. Protector
10. Mentor
11. Guide
12. Muse
13. Inspirer
14. Enchantress
15. Sorceress
16. Priestess
17. Oracle
18. Paragon

20. Idol
